title.narrative: Advancing Inclusion and Social Cohesion through Action Against Racism and Discrimination in Mexico

description.narrative: Racism, discrimination and exclusion continue to affect the opportunities and participation of many groups in Mexico, including Afro-descendant peoples, Indigenous peoples, and persons with disabilities. Building on UNESCO’s Roadmap Against Racism and Discrimination, the Global Forum against Racism, and the work done with UNFPA and AECID on afro Mexicans, this initiative will strengthen capacities, dialogue and awareness to promote more inclusive and cohesive societies. Through policy dialogues, consultations, capacity-building activities, youth engagement and dissemination of good practices, UNESCO Mexico will strengthen the capacities of stakeholders to address discrimination, racism and exclusion
